kurz: Cream turns into butter if you shake it long enough.
bild_im_kopf: Like dance couples finally finding each other after a long crush: at first each fat droplet floats alone, then everything sticks together.
beobachtung: First the cream turns foamy, then firm, then it suddenly separates into a yellow lump and white buttermilk.
erklaerung: Shaking tears open the shells of the fat droplets, and they stick together into ever larger lumps. That is exactly what happens when whipped [[sahne|cream]] is whipped too long.
schritte: Pour the cream into the jar and close it tightly.
Shake hard for about 10–15 minutes, taking turns.
When a lump and liquid separate, pour off the liquid.
Rinse the butter with cold water and salt it.
